state.task: Two agents analysed Java code for path traversal (CWE-22). Their final answers follow, then the code of each method in question.
agent_answers: {"findings": [{"cwe": "CWE-22", "class": "InputStreamHelper", "method": "processZipStream", "explanation": "The method processes zip entries without adequate sanitization of the entry names, allowing attacker-controlled data from ZipEntry.getName() to reach FileOutputStream constructors through the File constructor and path-based sinks, with only a basic canonical path check that can be bypassed by manipulating the zip entry names to include directory traversal sequences."}]}
